versions.content: UDS Service handling for all diagnostic services defined in ISO 14229-2 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall implement the protocol handling for all UDS services defined in ISO 14229-2. Rationale: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall be the central service handler for UDS diagnostics. ▽ 28 of 75 Document ID 4: AUTOSAR_FO_RS_Diagnostics Requirements on Diagnostics AUTOSAR FO R25-11 △ AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Interaction with UDS compliant tester on Ethernet. Supporting Material: ISO 14229
